title: A converging lens relates object and image distances
description: Use the thin-lens equation for a positive focal length.
assumptions: f = 0.1 m; object distance x is measured from the lens and is positive for a real object.
Image distance = fx/(x − f). Positive values indicate a real image under this convention.

diagrams.caption: At twice the focal length, the image is also at twice the focal length. The focal point is a pole, not a connecting segment.
